description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Layout_Vertical', which extends 'Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal' to implement a vertical layout for graph elements, including methods for calculating absolute sizes and splitting layout areas based on percentages.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Vertical
classes.description: A layout class for arranging elements vertically, extending the horizontal layout class to split areas on top of each other.

methods.name: _getAbsolute
methods.description: Calculates the absolute size of a layout part based on auto sizes and fill height.

methods.name: _split
methods.description: Splits the layout between two parts based on a specified percentage.
